observation: apps/deck's editor used NativeSelect for every choice (action, mode, target, page, grid size). The maintainer asked for the design-system Select instead: the browser-native popup does not match the GDG surface, menu styling or keyboard model. No current detector catches it: import-policy matches module paths, and NativeSelect ships from @gdgjp/design-system itself.
scope: design.components: every screen that renders a single-choice control.

rule.requirement: Screens use Select (SelectTrigger/SelectContent/SelectItem) for one choice from a list, not NativeSelect.
rule.source: DESIGN.md Forms and selection: Select for one choice from a larger set; maintainer decision 2026-10-24
rule.fix: Replace NativeSelect/NativeSelectOption with Select, SelectTrigger, SelectValue, SelectContent and SelectItem; pass name to Select when a form posts the value.

decision.reason: Chosen by the maintainer: MUST for all apps with a detector (design-system Select instead of the browser-native select).
